failure.title: Client History journey depended on an earlier test completing its session
failure.note: The isolated zero-retry client run retained exact browser and network evidence when History expected session 701 completed even though the API correctly returned it as scheduled.
failure.diagnosis: QA-CLI-007 implicitly relied on earlier QA-CLI-004/005 state mutation instead of arranging its own prerequisite, so isolated or first-failure-filtered execution made a correct History view appear defective.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
